content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed network management system (NMS) — site/link topology design + utilization ingest + incident reporting + change request workflow — as an auditable, open-source reference implementation.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native network operations primitives open to any AT Protocol client.

content.findings: Topology = undirected sites + capacity-bearing links sufficient for L1/L2 backbone NMS. SEV/risk DMNs auto-route public notice and CAB approval.
content.recommendations: Add streaming-telemetry sub for sub-minute samples, add path-impact analysis for change risk, integrate IPAM/BGP project.
